# Crovan — Delta 🐊

Kroc-Sauria is now **Crovan**: one app, two modes — **Meko** for your phone and **Rimas** for classroom smart panels.

## ✨ What's New

- 🟣 **Rimas — Panel mode** — Turns a tablet or smart panel into a file drop. It waits in Receive with a large QR code; scan it from your phone and send.
- 🔄 **Self-refreshing QR** — A fresh code every 10 minutes, after every transfer and whenever the connection drops, so the QR on screen always works.
- 🟢 **Mode dot** — A small dot beside the title shows the mode (🟢 Meko / 🟣 Rimas). Hold it to switch; a single tap does nothing.
- 📷 **Scan panel QR** — Send straight to a panel from the Send screen. The scanner now reads QR codes on screens reliably.
- 🧭 **Redesigned Send & Receive** — Clear ①②③ steps, the code shown large, extras tucked into a ⋮ menu, and a full-width action button. Quick mode has been removed.
- ⚡ **Instant switching** — Send and Receive stay ready side by side, so switching (or swiping) is instant — even on smart panels.
- 🎨 **New name and icon** — Kroc-Sauria becomes Crovan, with a new crocodile icon and an Android themed icon.

## ⚠️ Important — Before You Install

Delta is signed with the **same release key as Triton**.

1. **Coming from Triton:** install the Delta APK directly — it updates over Triton and keeps your history and settings.
2. **Coming from Dawn or Requiem:** uninstall the old version first (the signing key changed in Triton).

The app now appears as **Crovan** in your launcher. Quick Transfer settings were removed along with Quick mode; everything else (Send, Receive, QR, history, settings) carries over.

## 📦 Based On

Crovan (formerly Kroc-Sauria) is a fork of [Croc](https://github.com/schollz/croc) by schollz.
The underlying Croc project and its original authors remain credited.
